0.text: These people don’t fear the goddess. They deserve their misery from the Valsunga Wyrms, but my orders are to keep the blasted creatures out of the town.

1.text: If you help me out I’ll make it worth your time in Dram...that is, if you return in one piece.

0.text: Good. Head down the path towards the Burning Forest and slay as many of those flying devils as you can.
You peasants are all the same. Always wanting a hand out, but never doing a damn thing to earn it.
I had my doubts that I’d ever see you again. Many a strong warrior has been swallowed whole by the fiery depths of that forest.
